ns2:section.sectionText: Principles of Macroeconomics, 3 hours. This course is an introduction to the principles of macroeconomics: macroeconomics deals with the economy -- particularly its health -- as a whole. The course will include the determinants of the nation's output, unemployment, inflation and economic growth. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Discovery, and UIUC Social Sciences course.
